data.title: One Park Central
data.about:
One Park Central is an exceptional mixed-use tower located in Jumeirah Village Circle. Boasting premium amenities, including dedicated fitness and wellness facilities, it offers a realm of luxury through meticulously crafted retail, commercial, and residential units. 

The project by Iman Developers, One Park Central, features studio to 2-bedroom apartments, 2-bedroom duplex units, and 3- and 4-bedroom penthouses. One Park Central at JVC enjoys a central location with easy access to key areas like Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina.

characteristics_module.title: One Park Central Iman Developer Combines Sophistication, Innovation, and Urban Charm.
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• One Park Central by Iman comprises 482 meticulously crafted residential apartments, 38 commercial units, and 6 retail spaces.
  • The architectural marvel includes five podium levels for commercial units and a rooftop terrace with multiple amenities.
  • One Park Central Apartments features about 60 facilities, ranging from a rooftop infinity pool to a kids play area.
  • One Park Central floor plan also provides residents with co-working spaces and multi-purpose halls to make working from home easier.
  • Residents can enjoy an active lifestyle with the availability of a fitness club, a yoga workspace, and a spin studio.
  • Strategically located, the tower offers a family-friendly environment to its residents.

location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Jumeirah Village Circle is also conveniently located near major road networks, providing seamless connectivity to other parts of Dubai. The proximity to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road makes commuting to key business districts, shopping malls, and entertainment hubs straightforward and efficient. Nearby landmarks such as Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah, and Mall of the Emirates are just a short drive away, offering a wealth of leisure and entertainment options. This strategic location combines the tranquility of a suburban setting with the vibrancy of city living, making One Park Central an ideal choice for those seeking a balanced lifestyle.

10 Minutes to Circle Mall
15 Minutes to Palm Jumeirah
15 Minutes to Dubai Marina
25 Minutes to Dubai Mall 
25 Minutes to Burj Khalifa

seo.metaDescription: Discover opulent living at One Park Central by Iman. The project, located in Jumeirah Village Circle, features studio to 4-bedroom units.

more_info.answer: One Park Central boasts over 60 premium amenities designed to elevate the living experience. These include dedicated fitness and wellness facilities, a rooftop pool, a premium fitness club, a yoga workspace, a spin studio, and more. Residents also enjoy exclusive services such as a professional concierge, onsite property management, 24/7 security, and maintenance and cleaning services.
more_info.question: What amenities are available at One Park Central?

more_info.answer: One Park Central is developed by Iman Developers, a reputable company known for its commitment to quality and innovation. Iman Developers have a track record of delivering exceptional residential and commercial projects in Dubai, ensuring high standards of design and construction.
more_info.question: Who are the developers behind One Park Central?

more_info.answer: Iman Developers have an impressive portfolio of projects in Dubai, each characterized by their architectural excellence and luxurious amenities. Some of their notable projects include The Park Avenue, Oxford Residence, and Oxford Villas, all of which highlight the developer’s dedication to creating premium living spaces.
more_info.question: What are some other projects by Iman Developers in Dubai?

more_info.answer: The apartments at One Park Central are meticulously crafted to embody modernity and style. Key features include luxury studios, 1 & 2-bedroom apartments, duplexes, and penthouses, some of which come with private pools. The residences are designed to offer comfort and refinement, with high-end finishes and thoughtful layouts that enhance the living experience.
more_info.question: What are the key features of One Park Central apartments?

more_info.answer: One Park Central stands out due to its strategic location in Jumeirah Village Circle, facing Central Park, and its extensive range of amenities. The development includes 482 residential units, 38 commercial units, and 6 retail spaces, providing a variety of luxurious living and commercial options. Its blend of sophisticated design, prime location, and comprehensive amenities makes it a premier choice for residents seeking an upscale lifestyle in Dubai.
